libs.note: BH-2312.0 (BH-2347). The read side of the builds of record: bor_list joins the jobs ledger's result and pr_url artifact feeds per project, bor_union adds local builds/*/RESULT the ledger does not name. Read-only; two worker GETs per bor_list call.

knobs.note: Rows per job_artifact_feed call in bor_list; a feed that returns this many sets BOR_TRUNCATED=1. 1000 is the jobs worker's list cap. Read as ${BOR_LIMIT:-500}.
